text-foreground" id="feedback">用户反馈与支持<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">为帮助技术团队更高效地定位并排查您遇到的问题，建议在反馈时提供详细的使用场景、操作路径以及相关的报错日志。您可以通过以下任意一种方式向我们反馈：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户反馈表（飞书）</strong>：填写 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="https://zhipu-ai.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcn6ZwXeNSwdfcJ6Q8XeWVb6C?from=navigation">用户反馈表</a>，适合一次性提交完整问题信息。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">应用内反馈</strong>：从右上角统一反馈入口或报错提示进入，详见下方 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#in-app-feedback">应用内反馈入口</a>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">GitHub Issues</strong>：前往 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="https://github.com/zai-org/feedback">zai-org/feedback</a> 提交 Issue，适合需要追踪进展、与团队公开讨论的问题。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">加入社群</strong>：扫码加入飞书或微信用户社群直接联系我们，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">优先推荐飞书社群</strong>，详见下方 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#community">加入社群</a>。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="in-app-feedback">应用内反馈入口<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 内置了统一的反馈体系。无论是主动提交建议，还是遇到报错时快速上报，都可以在应用内直接完成。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="unified-entry">统一反馈入口<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击右上角的反馈入口，即可展开统一菜单，常用的反馈与支持能力都收拢在这里：</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/feedback-entry-menu-20260705.jpg" alt="右上角统一反馈入口菜单" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">问题上报</strong>：打开「提交反馈」面板，提交 Bug、异常表现等问题，支持附带截图与日志。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">给产品提需求</strong>：希望支持的新能力或体验优化，通过这里直达产品团队。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户社群</strong>：快速获取飞书 / 微信社群入口，加入后可直接与官方团队交流。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">产品文档</strong>：跳转到当前文档站，随时查阅使用说明。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导出日志</strong>：手动导出本地日志压缩包，用于反馈表或 Issue 附件。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="error-entry">报错提示入口<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果界面出现错误提示，可以直接点击提示条右侧的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">反馈问题</strong>。这种入口会自动带入报错摘要、现场截图和当前会话信息，适合反馈初始化失败、运行时报错等问题。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/feedback-error-banner-20260705.jpg" alt="报错提示条中的反馈问题入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="submit-feedback">填写并提交反馈<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">进入「提交反馈」面板后，按引导补全以下字段即可提交：</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/feedback-submit-dialog-20260705.jpg" alt="提交反馈面板字段说明" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">问题描述</strong>：说明遇到的问题与复现步骤，描述越具体，定位越快。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">截图</strong>：支持粘贴、拖拽或选择文件，最多可附 5 张；从报错入口进入时会自动带上现场截图。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">联系方式</strong>：留下邮箱等联系方式，便于我们在需要更多信息时与你联系。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">日志</strong>：点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">上传诊断日志</strong> 后，底部的日志上传选项会默认开启，也可以随时手动关闭。上传的日志我们已做 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">脱敏处理</strong>，会尽量保障你的隐私安全。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="my-feedback">我的反馈：处理状态与工单 ID<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在「提交反馈」面板左下角点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">我的反馈</strong>，可以查看每条反馈的处理进度：状态分为 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已提交、开发中、已解决</strong> 三种，每条反馈都会生成一个全局唯一的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工单 ID</strong>（形如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">fb-20260712-9f21</code>），点击右侧图标即可复制。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260801-feedback/feedback-my-feedback-annotated.webp" alt="我的反馈：状态列显示已提交、开发中、已解决，右侧是可复制的工单 ID" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">工单 ID 是该条反馈在反馈平台中的唯一索引，关联着你提交的问题描述、截图、诊断日志与环境信息。在社群沟通或跟进问题进展时，请附上对应的工单 ID：开发同学可以凭此直接检索到完整的反馈上下文，省去重复描述与信息收集环节，显著缩短问题的定位、复现与修复周期。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="github-format">GitHub Issue 提交格式<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">为方便我们快速复现和定位问题，建议在 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="https://github.com/zai-org/feedback">zai-org/feedback</a> 提交 Issue 时按以下格式描述：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">标题</strong>：一句话概括问题，例如「macOS 上启动后白屏」「Bot @ 触发任务无响应」。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">使用环境</strong>：操作系统及版本、ZCode 版本、所接入的模型通道（如 Z.ai 或企业模型通道）。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">复现步骤</strong>：分步骤说明如何稳定触发该问题，便于团队按相同路径复现。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">期望表现 vs 实际表现</strong>：分别描述您期望发生的结果和实际看到的现象。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">日志与截图</strong>：参照下方 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#package-logs">如何打包日志</a> 附上日志压缩包；如有截图、录屏请一并上传。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">若您不确定属于 Bug 还是使用问题，也欢迎直接提交，团队会协助分类与处理。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="package-logs">如何打包日志？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">推荐优先使用 ZCode 软件内置的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导出日志</strong> 功能；如果导出失败，再按下方说明手动定位日志目录。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="mac-os">macOS 系统<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击右上角统一反馈入口，展开反馈菜单。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导出日志</strong>，按提示保存生成的日志压缩包。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">将压缩包上传至反馈表中。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如果导出失败，可在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Finder</strong> 中选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">前往 -&gt; 前往文件夹...</strong>，输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode</code> 后手动压缩 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">logs</code> 文件夹。</li>
</ol>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="windows">Windows 系统<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击右上角统一反馈入口，展开反馈菜单。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导出日志</strong>，按提示保存生成的日志压缩包。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">将压缩包上传至反馈表中。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如果导出失败，可打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">文件资源管理器</strong>，在地址栏输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">%USERPROFILE%\\.zcode</code> 并回车。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">进入目录后，选中 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">logs</code> 文件夹，右键选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">发送到 -&gt; 压缩(zipped)文件夹</strong>。</li>
</ol>
